summary: ISR stub table in idt_stubs.S used the invalid NASM token-pasting syntax isr_stub_%[i] inside a %rep loop; it had to be rewritten as isr_stub_%+i.
string.c and selftest.c used uint8_t/uintptr types without including <stdint.h>.
Allocator self-test referenced an undefined constant HEAP_SIZE_FOR_TEST for the post-free coalescing allocation; replaced with a literal 512KB.
mkfs_tinyfs host tool called an undefined/ad-hoc strlen_local helper instead of including <string.h> and using strlen.
Kernel .bss was never zeroed because objcopy -O binary drops NOBITS sections, so the raw disk-loaded kernel had uninitialized globals; entry.S now zeroes _bss_start.._bss_end.
evidence:
; Zero .bss: the raw disk-loaded kernel image has no zero-fill
    ; guarantee (objcopy -O binary drops NOBITS sections entirely).

summary: Makefile used host:fs seed spec pairs (tests/hello.tsh:hello.tsh) directly as disk image prerequisites, which are not valid file targets; split into MKFS_SEED_FILES and MKFS_SEED_SPECS.
evidence:
# host-path:fs-name pairs seeded into every disk image; the host paths
# alone are listed separately so they can be used as make prerequisites

summary: A comment in mkfs_tinyfs.c contained 'tests/*.tsh', whose '/*' triggered a nested-comment compiler warning.
evidence: Clean kernel build; fixing a minor comment-nesting warning in the host tool.

summary: eval_binop handled TOK_PLUS only in the string-concat branch, so int+int fell through to return 0, making sums 0 and 'i = i + 1' an infinite loop.
evidence: `eval_binop` never handles `TOK_PLUS` for two ints — only the string-concat path checks it, so int+int silently falls through to `default: return VAL_ZERO`

summary: After raising the kernel budget to 512 sectors, stage2's single INT13h AH=0x42 read of the whole kernel silently failed (SeaBIOS per-call sector limit), so boot hung before SELFTEST; fixed by a 64-sector chunked read loop.
evidence: run_tests: FAIL - timed out waiting for 'SELFTEST PASS'

summary: README demo transcript listed a hand-written placeholder size for hello.tc (206) that did not match the real disk image (272).
evidence: updating the exact sizes (281/272 vs my placeholder 281/206)
